newsitem.title: CANADA: Tembec to issue C$75 mln of receipts.
newsitem.headline: Tembec to issue C$75 mln of receipts.

text.p: Tembec Inc said on Monday that it planned to offer about C$75 million of subscription receipts.

It said that proceeds from the offering, along with a bank loan, would be used to fund the proposed acquisition of the shares of Spruce Falls Acquisition Corp not owned by Tembec. The offering would consist of receipts representing the right to receive one class A share of Tembec on completion of the acquisition. Tembec now owns about 46 percent of Spruce Falls, which along with mill employees and local residents, owns the Spruce Falls facility in Kapuskasing, Ontario.

Tembec said it intended to offer holders of Spruce Falls Acquisition Corp one class A share of Tembec (the share option) or C$7 cash and 0.3 class A share of Tembec (the combination offer) at their option, for each SFAC share. The offers are subject to the provision that a minimum of 5 million and maximum of 12,157,000 class A shares of Tembec, subject to an adjustment, can be issued under the offer.
Tembec said it would ensure a minimum value of C$10 a share for the class A shares by issuing additional class A shares or by making a cash payment to the SFAC shareholders.

Tembec said that as announced on January 22, it will also be issuing an additional 0.3 Class A share of Tembec to the holders of 1,032,081 Class 1 special shares, and the holders of 1,170,362 Class 3 restricted voting special shares of SFAC to be purchased on February 11.
Upon completion of that purchase, Tembec will own about 51 percent of the outstanding equity of SFAC. It will then make an offer for the roughly 17.5 million shares of SFAC not owned by Tembec.
The acquisition of SFAC will improve Tembec's working capital and result in a stronger company with the ability to compete more effectively in its forest products markets, the company said.
Spruce Falls operates an integrated 360,000 tonne newsprint and lumber manufacturing plant in Kapuskasing, Ontario.
